title: HOW TO NAE NAE | Dance TUTORIAL ft The Iconic Boyz (Hip Hop Moves) | DANCE TUTORIALS LIVE

extraction.teacher_style: The instructors break down steps clearly in sections with counts and verbal guidance. They demonstrate at a steady pace and encourage practice with music.
cues: Make sure you really bend those knees
Make sure your fingers are really spread out

steps_taught.name: Step 1
steps_taught.description: Bend knees, feet parallel, step back right, left, right, left

steps_taught.name: Step 2
steps_taught.description: Step with right foot, lean body into it and turn chest

steps_taught.name: Step 3
steps_taught.description: Arm up high with spread fingers, bending legs and moving arm across

what_works: Clear breakdown of steps by different crew members
what_hinders: Multiple instructors switching in and out can feel slightly disjointed

quotes.text: The first step to Nae Naeing is bending your knees
The next step to do the Nae Nae is to add your swag into it
The third and final step to doing the Nae Nae is putting your arm way up high
